_about: Content kept in data/gloss but left out of (or reworded in) the built app data by scripts/build_data.py, so the shipped text suits young children. Every rule must still match the gloss, or the build fails. See README > Hidden content.

hideSteinsaltz._about: Mishnayos whose Steinsaltz text (stIntro, st, stMore) is dropped. Their pieces then show only the simple meaning, with no Steinsaltz toggle.
hideSteinsaltz.1:1: Steinsaltz describes the tumtum's hidden sexual organs.
hideSteinsaltz.1:4: Steinsaltz describes executing a pregnant woman at once and a woman in labor.
hideSteinsaltz.2:1: Steinsaltz names a discharge of blood, menstruation and the zava.
hideSteinsaltz.3:1: Steinsaltz names a rapist and a seducer.
hideSteinsaltz.3:4: Steinsaltz speaks of rape and seduction throughout.
hideSteinsaltz.3:5: Steinsaltz names rape and seduction and a bride who was not a virgin.
